forbidden_inputs: case files or case-specific structured events
VeSMed V5 distillations, trajectories, rankings, or expected outputs
target-case measurements, dates, interventions, diagnoses, or outcomes
blindness_contract.declaration: No patient-specific value, time point, expected diagnosis, or outcome was used to select this topology or its parameters.

scope.purpose: Mechanism-aware longitudinal belief-state experiment over a deliberately small differential-process set.
scope.coordinate_domain: all continuous branch-local coordinates are normalized to [0,1] unless otherwise stated
scope.observation_policy: Only typed observations available at the current cut may update belief.
scope.action_policy: Only PerformedTreatment or PerformedProcedure events alter dynamics; planned or considered actions do not.
scope.coexistence_policy: The hidden state may contain more than one active process. Mutually exclusive single-label normalization is forbidden.

inference_prior_policy.default_for_structural_tests: exchangeable sparse prior over known candidate-process subsets, with a separately represented unknown branch
inference_prior_policy.known_branch_rule: Distribute the remaining mass without using target-case labels; report sensitivity rather than treating the default as prevalence.
inference_prior_policy.background_rule: APS, reserve, and performed exposure context may modulate activation through registered factors or transition gates, but may not be counted again as an extra prior bonus.
inference_prior_policy.reporting_rule: If a branch ordering or action rollout changes materially across the registered prior ensemble, label the output PRIOR_SENSITIVE.

stable_or_slow_coordinates.meaning: Renal functional reserve before the active process
Capacity to tolerate or recover from red-cell and platelet loss
Pulmonary reserve before the active process
Slow or stable susceptibility to dysregulated complement amplification

aps_modulation_hypotheses.note: APS is treated as a permissive background, not proof of the active branch.
The strength and patient-level relevance of this interaction are not identified by the blind package.

background_state.double_count_guard: APS may modify branch activation or trajectory, but it must not also be added as a separate copy of the same thrombosis or complement evidence.

allowed_concurrent_sets.rule: Any nonempty subset of candidate-process branches is representable unless a future scope version supplies evidence for a hard incompatibility. Unknown may coexist with any known subset.
allowed_concurrent_sets.regularization: Sparse active sets are a computational prior only; they must not make coexistence impossible.

forbidden_shortcuts: Do not force exactly one active branch.
Do not let procedure or drug exposure alone prove a complication branch.
Do not turn APS into an active-process answer without separate evidence.
Do not use a treatment response as deterministic branch identity.

distance_rule.within_branch: weighted local-chart distance with posterior uncertainty
distance_rule.across_branch: shortest legal path through shared parent and bridge costs
distance_rule.concurrent_state: set-aware distance over active branches plus shared-latent consistency
distance_rule.prohibited: flat Euclidean distance across incompatible local coordinates

definitions.compensated: Active mechanism may be present, but reserve and support keep organ-level output near baseline; latent load can still rise.
definitions.strained: Reserve is being consumed or compensatory effort/support is increasing; surface observations may lag mechanism progression.
definitions.decompensated: Reserve is insufficient for current load; organ-level consequences accelerate and abrupt jumps are allowed.
definitions.recovering: Mechanism load or event source is falling and recovery momentum is positive; residual injury and action effects may persist.

hysteresis.rule: Entry and exit use different guards and depend on recovery momentum plus action memory; identical coordinates may therefore imply different drift in different modes.

branch_overrides.direct_jump: performed biopsy plus source activation may jump directly from compensated/reference to strained or decompensated
branch_overrides.recovery_guard: falling blood-loss latent and increasing hemostatic stability

branch_overrides.activation_guard: heparin exposure memory is necessary but not sufficient
branch_overrides.recovery_guard: platelet activation falls; thrombosis burden can persist after platelet recovery

branch_overrides.mode_note: renal and pulmonary compartments may occupy different strain levels; aggregate mode retains uncertainty rather than averaging them away

context_nodes.source: method, sample quality, and reference metadata
performed, pending, unavailable, or resulted state
performed support and residual action memory

factors.residual_dependence: positive residual correlation retained within the block
factors.audit_rule: The block emits one likelihood term. Its child observations must not be multiplied again as independent branch votes.
This factor is the hemoglobin marginal of F_HEMOLYSIS_PANEL_JOINT and is not an additional term when the joint block is active.
One platelet-count likelihood term is shared across TMA, TTP, and HIT explanations.
Creatinine and eGFR are coupled transforms, not independent evidence.
Urine findings remain nonspecific and are not direct branch labels.
Absence of hemoptysis alone cannot switch off pulmonary hemorrhage; respiratory support is modeled as observation masking.
Biopsy exposure enables but does not prove bleeding; hemoglobin remains shared with other causes.
Immunoassay and functional assay are not treated as independent copies of the same immune mechanism.
APS and HIT can share thrombotic outputs; the observation does not identify which parent caused it.
Organ observations already consumed by a more specific joint block are shared marginals, not extra votes.
Each assay family contributes once and is conditioned on method/context; no assay is a deterministic branch label.
Complement component and terminal-activation observations are imperfect correlated evidence and are not multiplied as independent direct labels.
Predisposition evidence modifies susceptibility; it is not current complement activity and is not counted again as an acute observation.

factor_scheduling.overlap_rule: Build maximal joint blocks first. If two blocks share an observed child, use a declared shared marginal or a junction-tree separator; never multiply the child twice.
factor_scheduling.missing_rule: Missing, not-yet-available, not-performed, and negative are distinct. Missing observations contribute no clinical likelihood but may contribute an availability-model term if selection is modeled.
factor_scheduling.conflict_rule: Discordant observations widen latent posterior or allocate unknown mass; they are not deleted.
factor_scheduling.lineage: Every posterior update records the factor IDs and observation event digests consumed.

ordinal_likelihoods.interpretation: These are deliberately broad normalized pseudo-likelihood kernels for structural experiments, not clinical frequencies.

inverse_marker_kernel.note: Apply the positive kernel after reversing the observation order; used for falling hemoglobin, platelets, haptoglobin, eGFR, or urine output.

absent_required_exposure.note: Small residual mass preserves event-record error and unusual exposure uncertainty; it does not establish clinical probability.

present_required_exposure.note: Exposure permits but does not establish the complication.

robustness.note: Ranges are sensitivity-analysis bounds and must be frozen before seeing target-case results.

temporal_kernel.rule: Direction of change and persistence are represented separately from cross-sectional level.
temporal_kernel.note: The symmetric default is intentionally weak until repeated observations exist.

dynamics.form: branch-and-mode-conditioned stochastic difference equation with action memory

mode_effects.compensated: organ reserve dampens observed organ consequences while mechanism coordinates may rise
mode_effects.strained: injury coordinates persist and reserve drifts down
mode_effects.decompensated: organ injury and circulatory strain may accelerate
mode_effects.recovering: mechanism and hemolysis drift down; organ recovery may lag

mode_effects.compensated: shared hematologic latents may be active before organ decompensation
mode_effects.strained: platelet consumption and microvascular burden outpace recovery
mode_effects.decompensated: organ injury can jump despite similar preceding surface counts
mode_effects.recovering: platelet and hemolysis recovery may precede recovery from residual organ injury

mode_effects.compensated: immune activity may precede overt organ loss
mode_effects.strained: renal or pulmonary compartment burden rises while reserve masks part of the output
mode_effects.recovering: immune activity can fall while structural renal loss persists

mode_effects.compensated: blood loss may be partly masked by reserve or support
mode_effects.strained: hematoma or blood-loss latent rises with maintained circulation
mode_effects.decompensated: circulatory strain accelerates or a bleed-source jump occurs
mode_effects.recovering: source activity falls; hemoglobin recovery may lag and support can mask the trend

mode_effects.compensated: immune activation may be present without overt thrombosis
mode_effects.strained: platelet consumption or thrombin generation rises
mode_effects.recovering: platelets may recover before established thrombosis burden resolves

noise.shared_latent_noise: correlated within each declared joint factor block

actions.interpretation: Simulator action classes only. Presence here is not a recommendation, indication, contraindication, or claim of patient-level benefit.

performed_procedure_exposures.biopsy: typed exposure interval with occurrence and availability lineage

action_memory_schema.heparin_exposure_history: typed performed exposure history with residual exposure state
action_memory_schema.red_cell_support: residual support level and observation-masking state
action_memory_schema.platelet_support: residual support level and observation-masking state
action_memory_schema.renal_support: active settings, residual effects, and measurement context
action_memory_schema.respiratory_support: active settings, residual effects, and measurement context
action_memory_schema.support_masking_state: shared summary of ongoing support effects on observed outputs

catalog.effect: advance current dynamics and decay existing action memory
maintain performed support settings; may mask surface observations without reducing source mechanism
remove ongoing support injection while residual effects decay; not equivalent to no new action

catalog.audit_note: A response cannot uniquely identify the branch because the action has multiple possible targets and concurrent actions may exist.

catalog.effect: inject exposure memory and alter coagulation state
stop new exposure injection; residual immune/action memory decays separately

catalog.audit_note: This opposing branch effect is intentionally preserved as a collision test, not converted into a recommendation.

catalog.effect: may raise measured hemoglobin and reduce strain without controlling hemolysis or bleeding source
may change measured platelet count without uniquely changing the active source mechanism
changes observed solute/volume outputs and reserve expression without proving source-mechanism control
changes measured oxygenation without directly proving pulmonary source control

constraints.rule: Only performed actions inject physiology or action memory. Planned, recommended, considered, and ordered-only events have zero physiologic effect.
NoNewAction, ContinueExistingSupport, and StopExistingSupport are distinct when residual or ongoing exposure exists.
Biopsy and heparin exposure are necessary context gates for their iatrogenic branches, not sufficient diagnostic evidence.
An action may improve one branch coordinate while worsening another; rollout must retain the concurrent posterior rather than select a single label first.
Support changes observation generation and reserve expression separately from source-mechanism dynamics.
If an action edge is not identified, output a sensitivity range or UNIDENTIFIABLE, not a directional patient-specific conclusion.
Counterfactual queries do not mutate factual state or action memory.

feasibility_semantics.purpose: Report whether the simulator has enough typed context to evaluate an action class; this is not clinical permission or advice.
rules: Missing required performed-exposure history yields CONTEXT_MISSING, not an imputed action response.
An unrepresented action, dose dependence, toxicity, or interaction yields SCOPE_INSUFFICIENT.
Opposing effects across material concurrent branches yields CONFLICTING_BRANCH_EFFECTS unless the joint rollout reports the full uncertainty range.
An unidentified patient-level effect yields UNIDENTIFIABLE even when a nominal mechanism direction is encoded.
STRUCTURALLY_EVALUABLE means only that the registered transition can run; it does not mean safe, indicated, or beneficial.

unknown_branch.purpose: Preserve probability mass for active processes, assay failures, or interactions not represented by the known branches.

likelihood.complexity_control: weak regularization against explaining everything; must be tuned only on non-target development data

mass_update_rules: Increase residual support when no known branch or allowed concurrent set explains the available joint factors without severe conflict.
Retain nonzero mass when direct assays are unavailable, discordant, or method-limited.
Do not collapse unknown mass merely because one known branch is the least bad fit.
Do not use a target-case-derived fixed likelihood cutoff.

causal_identifiability_register.reason: Background association does not identify individual causal contribution.
Interaction strength and direction may vary and are not identified by this blind package.
No randomized or otherwise identified individual counterfactual is present in the package.

causal_identifiability_register.edge: observed response after action -> active branch identity
causal_identifiability_register.reason: Concurrent actions, spontaneous drift, support masking, and multi-target actions prevent deterministic inversion.

causal_identifiability_register.edge: hemoglobin fall -> hemolysis versus bleeding source
causal_identifiability_register.reason: The same observed node has several latent parents.
A single platelet observation is shared across branches.

causal_identifiability_register.edge: renal dysfunction -> complement TMA versus anti-GBM versus background reserve
causal_identifiability_register.reason: Renal output is downstream of multiple renal injury latents and reserve.
Procedure exposure is necessary context but does not establish the complication.
Exposure permits but does not establish PF4-dependent platelet activation.

hard_failures: observation child counted more than once outside a declared junction separator
single-label normalization erases an allowed concurrent process
flat Euclidean comparison across incompatible charts
patient-level action conclusion emitted through an unidentified edge
unknown mass forced to zero by construction
required_ablations: remove shared-latent joint blocks and measure overconfidence
remove mode and test same-coordinate divergent futures
remove action memory and test support/exposure masking collisions
force single active branch and test concurrent-process failures
remove unknown branch and measure forced-fit behavior
replace topology distance with flat Euclidean distance
audit_contract.freeze_rule: Topology, ordinal kernels, action edges, and evaluation thresholds must be frozen before target-case replay. Any post-replay change creates a new model version and requires fresh blinded evaluation.
